status: Designed layout and interaction contract; implementation and assistive-technology verification remain outstanding.

shared.readingOrder: Page title/status, error summary, main content and field errors, contextual evidence, actions. DOM order follows visual order when implemented.
shared.navigation: Skip link to main; narrow menu opens a focused drawer, Escape closes and focus returns to its trigger; never depend on hover.
shared.focus: Visible 2 px contrasting focus ring; logical Tab/Shift+Tab order; interactive target at least 48 x 48 CSS px; no keyboard trap outside modal.
shared.dialog: Move focus to labelled dialog heading; keep focus inside while open; error summary links to fields; Escape/cancel restores trigger focus; destructive action is never initial focus.
shared.errors: Retain input and attachment state; focus error summary on failed submission; field-level message includes correction; announce asynchronous changes politely without stealing focus.
shared.textExpansion: Allow 200% text sizing and long locale strings with vertical growth; no fixed-height clipping, truncated critical labels or horizontal page scrolling at 320 px.
shared.tables: Real labelled headers; labelled cards or disclosure on narrow layouts; preserve sort/filter context; accessible table accompanies charts.
shared.media: Fit without distortion; preserve exact coordinate/dimension provenance; keyboard/numeric alternative to pointer selection; optional media has low-bandwidth fallback.
shared.asyncAndOffline: Show pending/unknown/rejected separately; preserve drafts with privacy controls; do not automatically replay release, handoff, financial or provider operations.
shared.localeAndTime: Show selected locale and explicit fallback; retain original raw input; label local time and UTC/offset with temporal uncertainty; locale review is independent.
shared.privacy: Role/tenant boundaries and unavailable private evidence remain intact at every breakpoint; hiding columns does not grant disclosure.
shared.motion: Respect reduced-motion preference; no status conveyed by motion or colour alone.
shared.acceptance: Concept layouts specify behavior; runtime keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, localization and browser/device tests are not claimed.

form.narrow: Single column; labels above fields; field help and errors follow their input; actions wrap below content.
form.medium: Single readable form column plus collapsible context; keep labels with inputs.
form.wide: Form and bounded contextual review panel; maximum form line length; primary action follows form.

search.narrow: Filters open a focused sheet; results as summary cards; selected detail is a separate route.
search.medium: Collapsible filters above result list; detail replaces list on selection.
search.wide: Filter rail, results and selected detail; preserve result position on return.

evidence.narrow: One private evidence section at a time; original input and derived interpretation labelled separately.
evidence.medium: Evidence and review stack in reading order; media fits container.
evidence.wide: Private evidence and current decision context side by side; never reveal secrets in summary.

decision.narrow: Current status, holds and scope first; evidence then guarded action; confirmation is a full-width dialog.
decision.medium: Stacked action form and contextual decision package; no hidden critical hold.
decision.wide: Action form and decision context in parallel; confirmation shows exact current version.

conversation.narrow: Chronological messages; composer follows latest message; attachment states inline.
conversation.wide: Conversation and case context side by side; private contact details remain excluded.

tag.narrow: QR has quiet zone and text alternative; print/write/manage actions stack; locator never truncated in exported artifact.
tag.medium: Tag preview and issuance details stack at intrinsic readable size.
tag.wide: Printable preview beside revocation and write state; print excludes owner data.

queue.narrow: Table rows become labelled cards; priority, custody and action stay visible; details on separate route.
queue.medium: Essential columns plus row detail; optional columns in disclosure.
queue.wide: Sortable queue with explicit column headings and accessible labelled row actions.

media.narrow: Fit source image without distorting coordinates; region/mask controls follow preview; numeric equivalent for pointer tools.
media.medium: Preview above form; keyboard region controls and approval details below.
media.wide: Source, numeric coordinates and disclosure preview in parallel; no hover-only tools.

audit.narrow: Chronological event cards preserve timestamp, timezone, provenance and correction relation.
audit.medium: Essential event columns with expanded detail.
audit.wide: Append-oriented event table and correction context; original event remains readable.

administration.narrow: Permission matrix becomes labelled scope cards; request summary follows; credential values stay hidden.
administration.medium: Scope groups collapse; current version remains visible.
administration.wide: Scope matrix and impact review side by side; no implicit cross-tenant selection.

operations.narrow: Severity, availability and exact operation reference first; no automatic critical resend.
operations.medium: Stack operation history and reconciliation controls.
operations.wide: Operation table with current health, original attempt and repair controls.

report.narrow: Filters in focused sheet; chart follows summary with equivalent accessible table; optional columns disclosed.
report.medium: Two-column summaries only where readable; charts and data tables stack.
report.wide: Report filters, denominator and charts with full tabular alternative; privacy suppression persists in exports.

failure.narrow: Plain-language status, preserved work and one safe next action; no implied successful side effect.
failure.wide: Status panel and recovery context; unknown, denied, unavailable and failed are distinct.
